title: Personal Carriage of Gems & Jewellery Export Parcels

business_rules.rule_description:
Procedure
for Personal Carriage of exports shall be as prescribed by Customs.
business_rules.trigger: Personal Carriage of Gems & Jewellery Export Parcels
business_rules.condition:
(b) For claiming Replenishment in case of Personal Carriage of Exports by
Foreign Bound passenger, documents shall be same as mentioned under
paragraph 4.81(c) of HBP.
business_rules.validation:
Procedure
for Personal Carriage of exports shall be as prescribed by Customs.
business_rules.exception:
Export proceeds shall, however, be realised through normal banking
channel.
business_rules.output: DEKAI should produce a compliance decision for 4.87 - Personal Carriage of Gems & Jewellery Export Parcels.
